jobs.description: Onboarding Customer Success Manager - TytoCare We're Hiring 👋 Consumers Resources (866) 971-8986 Health systems Community health Health plans Solution Solution Home Smart Clinic Enabling remote physical exams from the home for accessible, high-quality virtual care Pro Smart Clinic Giving patients access to high-quality healthcare wherever they are Tyto Engagement Labs™ Enhancing user engagement with behavioral science, real-world insights, and thorough A/B testing Pro Smart Clinic stories Stories that show how TytoCare impacts patients and health systems across different use cases. Discover how TytoCare uses AI and data to deliver real clinical insights—bringing high-quality, remote care into the home. Learn more Talk to us Request a demo Use cases Book a demo Back to all positions Share Onboarding Customer Success Manager Apply for this position TytoCare is transforming the way care is delivered by enabling leading health plans and health systems to provide remote physical exams, closing the care gap. TytoCare’s Home and Pro Smart Clinic solutions extend high-quality care into homes and community settings, including schools, work sites, urgent care centers, and rural clinics, while leveraging proven engagement models and one of the world’s largest proprietary multi-modal clinical datasets, built from millions of real-world encounters, to power our FDA-cleared, award-winning AI. Founded in 2012, TytoCare is trusted by more than 240 leading organizations across the U.S., Europe, Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East. Our partners consistently see utilization rates six times higher than traditional telehealth, an average 8.5% reduction in total cost of care, and 11.3% fewer Emergency Department visits, with an average NPS of 83. We’re looking for a highly motivated Onboarding Customer Success Manager to lead complex customer implementations, ensuring customers are set up for long-term success from day one. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor throughout the onboarding journey, partnering with customers and collaborating with internal teams to deliver exceptional implementation experiences. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining project management, customer engagement, and problem-solving every day. What you’ll do: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the onboarding and implementation lifecycle, providing end-to-end project management for your portfolio of accounts Be a subject matter expert in TytoCare’s product offerings clearly communicating product capabilities to customers, ranging from executives to end-users Lead complex, cross-functional implementations, coordinating with internal and customer stakeholders to ensure successful product deployment Proactively identify project risks, remove roadblocks, and drive projects to completion while keeping stakeholders informed Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve software and hardware issues in collaboration with internal teams and customers Monitor, gather, and analyze data from various products and 3rd party systems to accelerate adoption and achieve customer and TytoCare goals Drive successful onboarding and implementation initiatives by delivering against defined success metrics Represent the voice of the customer, championing feedback and insights into product enhancements and improvements for the Product and Engineering teams Travel nationwide to customer sites to support implementations as needed To be successful in this role, you’ll need: Bachelor’s degree 2+ years of experience in implementation, project management, customer success, or account management role Experience working with healthcare providers and/or payers preferred Experience supporting chronic care, virtual care, population health, or disease management programs, with knowledge of COPD or other chronic conditions strongly preferred Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional customer implementations from planning through execution Ability to understand clinical and operational workflows and translate them into practical implementation plans that support long-term patient engagement, utilization, and measurable outcomes Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders at all organizational levels, including executive leadership A proactive, self-driven mindset with the ability to thrive in ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities, and solve complex problems A positive, solutions-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability Salary Range: $85,000-100,000 per year Share this opportunity: Apply Learn more Talk to us Request a demo Use cases Book a demo Back to all positions Share Product Analytics Manager Netanya, Israel Apply for this position About TytoCare TytoCare is transforming the way care is delivered by enabling leading health plans and health systems to provide remote physical exams, closing the care gap. TytoCare’s Home and Pro Smart Clinic solutions extend high-quality care into homes and community settings, including schools, work sites, urgent care centers, and rural clinics, while leveraging proven engagement models and one of the world’s largest proprietary multi-modal clinical datasets, built from millions of real-world encounters, to power our FDA-cleared, award-winning AI. Founded in 2012, TytoCare is trusted by more than 240 leading organizations across the U.S., Europe, Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East. Our partners consistently see utilization rates six times higher than traditional telehealth, an average 8.5% reduction in total cost of care, and 11.3% fewer Emergency Department visits, with an average NPS of 83. About this role We’re looking for an experienced Product Analytics Manager to play a key role as part of the Product organization. The Product Analytics Manager will lead the domain at TytoCare and work closely with Product, R&D, Sales and Marketing, Customer Success, and BI to drive data-informed product and business decisions. Key Responsibilities Define product success metrics, usage benchmarks, and adoption KPIs across products and customer segments, ensuring alignment with TytoCare’s clinical and business impact goals. Own the end-to-end product analytics framework — including event design, tracking strategy, data validation, and ongoing data quality monitoring. Perform hands-on deep-dive analyses, working directly with raw data and collaborating with R&D and BI to ensure robust data models, pipelines, and instrumentation. Partner with Customer Success and BI to deliver customer-centric insights and support the evolution of the product data infrastructure. Build dashboards and analytical models to support product and business decision-making, evaluate feature performance, and establish a continuous feedback loop between user behavior and product development — using data-driven insights to challenge assumptions and prioritize high-impact roadmap initiatives. Quantify the clinical and economic impact of TytoCare solutions by analyzing real-world encounter data to validate key performance markers such as reduction in cost of care, improved patient outcomes, and product utilization. Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Provide professional leadership in analytics, including team management (if applicable) and contributing to the growth of the analytics function. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (engineering, statistics, data science, or similar). 5+ years of Product Analytics experience in SaaS environments (healthcare or regulated industries – advantage). Strong hands-on experience working with large datasets and complex databases, including advanced SQL proficiency and data modeling. Experience implementing and maintaining product instrumentation and analytics tracking frameworks. Experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude, Heap) and BI tools. Ability to operate both strategically and technically — connecting business goals with analytical execution and data infrastructure. Strong analytical mindset with a passion for data-driven product development.
